name: TotA Meter
description: DPS meter and Build Tester for you and your pet: DPS and peak, damage per skill, max hit, uses per minute, crits, estimated focus per cast, combos, damage by type and Combat/Alt deck split, with snapshots at 1, 3 and 5 minutes on the Training Dummy. Tracks artifacts, Crowns of the Obsidians and blueprints you loot. Exports your decks, skill levels and XP to Tools of the Avatar.
author: Tools of the Avatar
